name: sentry
summary: Sentry's hosted MCP server (issues, errors, traces, projects) with browser sign-in
notes: Sign in with your Sentry account in the browser: lotr setup sentry. The server's discovery document advertises dynamic client registration; nothing to create first.
scopes is left empty: the server decides. Sentry's page names none; its discovery document lists org:read, project:write, team:write, event:write, alerts:write.
To limit the tools, the vendor documents org-scoped and project-scoped URLs: https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp/{organizationSlug}[/{projectSlug}]. Edit connect.url (and keep the host) if you want that.
Alternative, local: npm package @sentry/mcp-server (stdio) with a Sentry user auth token and --host for self-hosted Sentry; self-hosted Sentry cannot use the hosted server.
smoke 'whoami' is named on the vendor's llms.txt; the docs do not state its arguments, so confirm it takes none.
The mcp-oauth kind takes no connect.policy; the gateway classes risky tool names (delete, send) as consent by itself.
